description: Build a daily wellness summary from local Apple Health export data. It is not live HealthKit and not medical advice.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD local date. Defaults to today in the configured timezone.

timezone.description: IANA timezone, e.g. America/Fortaleza. Defaults to APPLE_HEALTH_TIMEZONE or UTC.

name: apple_health_daily_summary
title: Apple Health Daily Summary
